prompt: Green trades lunch for a dinosaur book
title: Dinosaur Book Trade
irony: Green trades away his lunch to read about hungry dinosaurs, only to grow the hungriest tummy of all, until shared pancakes bring the facts to life.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Green and Navy share pancakes at Gold's Diner while Purple waves a shiny dinosaur book outside.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green lists dinosaur facts, wants the book, and clutches his lunch tray, scared to trade.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Purple offers the dinosaur book for Green's lunch, and Navy gasps while Green freezes.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The friends chant about the dinosaur book as Green holds his lunch tight.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Green trades his lunch for the book, then his tummy rumbles too loud to read.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Hungry Green roars like a T. rex, grabs the book upside down, and Navy shares a pancake.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The friends chant about the dinosaur book as Green's tummy rumbles along.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold watches hungry Green and remembers secretly buying soup for Silver on rainy days.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold decides to split his pancakes between Green and Navy, keeping nothing extra back.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The friends chant, and Gold sings how shared pancakes beat a lonely book.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Green and Navy share pancakes at Gold's Diner, reading dinosaur facts aloud together.
